cron: begin read only;select jobid,jobname,schedule,active,md5(command) as command_md5 from cron.job order by jobid;rollback;
collector_archive: begin read only;select source_relation,count(*) as versions,min(payload->>'started_at') as first_started,max(payload->>'started_at') as last_started,max(source_observed_at) as observed_through,encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(encode(sha256(convert_to(payload::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),'' order by encode(sha256(convert_to(payload::text,'UTF8')),'hex')),'UTF8')),'hex') as payload_multiset_sha256 from mip_private.collector_row_versions group by source_relation;rollback;
collector_source: begin isolation level repeatable read read only;select now() as observed_at,'ingestion_runs' as relation,'retained_time_range' as scope,count(*) as rows,encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),'' order by encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex')),'UTF8')),'hex') as payload_multiset_sha256 from public.ingestion_runs t where started_at<='2026-09-10T05:25:05.75618+00:00'::timestamptz union all select now(),'ingestion_source_runs','retained_time_range',count(*),encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),'' order by encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex')),'UTF8')),'hex') from public.ingestion_source_runs t where run_id in(select run_id from public.ingestion_runs where started_at<='2026-09-10T05:25:05.75618+00:00'::timestamptz) union all select now(),'ingest_sources','current',count(*),encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),'' order by encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex')),'UTF8')),'hex') from public.ingest_sources t union all select now(),'ingestion_runs','after_retained_time_range',count(*),encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),'' order by encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex')),'UTF8')),'hex') from public.ingestion_runs t where started_at>'2026-09-10T05:25:05.75618+00:00'::timestamptz union all select now(),'ingestion_source_runs','after_retained_time_range',count(*),encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),'' order by encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex')),'UTF8')),'hex') from public.ingestion_source_runs t where run_id in(select run_id from public.ingestion_runs where started_at>'2026-09-10T05:25:05.75618+00:00'::timestamptz);rollback;
